SPECIFICATION FOR BURNER PLIERS
0. FOREWORD
0.1 This Indian Standard was adopted by the Indian Standards Institution on 18 May 1966, after the draft finalized by the Hand Tools Sectional Committee had been approved by the Mechanical Erigineering Division Council. 0.2 This standard has been formulated with a view to ensure a minimum standard of quality of the tools so that they will have a longer useful life. Also;this standard specifies certain basic overall dimensions of functional importance only without imposing` any limitation of details of design. 0.3 Pqr the preparation of this standard, assistance has been derived from PN M-64472 Pliers for burners issued by Polski Komitet Normalizacyjny. 0.4 For the purpose of deciding whether a particular requirement of this standard is complied with, the final value, observed or calculated, expressing the result of a test, shall be rounded off in accordance with IS : 2-1960*. The number of significant places retained in the rounded off value should be the same as that of the specified value in this standard.

1. SCOPE 1.1 This standard covers the requirements for burner pliers. 2. NOMENCLATURE 2.1 For the IS : 2615-1964t 3. GENERAL of purpose shall apply. this standard, nomenclature as given in

REQUIREMENTS

3.1 The material, manufacture, workmanship and finish, tests, preservation and packing and sampling shall conform to IS : 2615-1964t.

5. HARDNESS 5.1 The pliers shall have a hardness of 450 IS : 1501-1959* ) or its equivalent in other scales. to 550 HV (see

5.2 The hardness shall be tested as specified in IS : 2615-1964-t. 6. WORK INSPECTION

6.1 The manufacturer shall maintain a system of works inspection at all stages ofmanufacture to ensure that the pliers are free from all manufacturing defects and comply in all respects with the requirements of this specification. 7. TESTING AND INSPECTION FACILITIES

7.1 The manufacturer shall supply the required sample or samples, the labour and appliances for such testing ( see also IS : 228-1959$ ) as may be carried out by the purchaser or his authorized representative in aocordance with this specification, at the premises of the manufacturer or at any other place mutually agreed upon.
*Method for Vicken hardness test for steel. tGenera1 requirements for pliers, pincers and nippers. SMethods of chemical analysis of pig iron, cast iron, and plain carbon steels ( revised) . and low-alloy

4

IS : 3569 - 1966 7.2 The purchaser or his authorized representative shall normally have free access to the works of the manufacturer at all reasonable, times to inspect the manufacture of pliers at,any stage. The manufacturer shall, however, have the option, subject tci mutual agreement prior.to the acceptance of gn order, to impose limitations on the foregoing. 8. MARKING 8.1 The pliers shall be clearly and legibly stamped with the manufacturer's name, initials and/or recognized trade-mark and year of manufacture, if required by the purchaser. 8.1.1 The pliers may also be marked with the IS1 Certification Mark.
use of the IS1 Certification Mark is governed by the provisions of the NOTE -The Indian Standards Institution' ( Certification Marks ) Act. and the Rules and Regulations made thereunder. Presence bf this mark on prod&s covered by an Indian Standard conveys the assurance that they have been produced to comply with the requirements of that standard, under a well-defined system of inspection, testing and quality control during production. This system, which is devised and supervised by IS1 and operated by the prod&r, has the further safeguard that the products as actually marketed are continuously checked by IS1 for conformity to the standard. Details of conditions, under which a licence for the use of the IS1 Certification Mark may be granted to manufacturers or processors, may be obtained from the Indian Standards Institution.

9. TESTS 9.0 In addition to the tests specified in IS : 2615.1964*, shall be carried out. the following-tests

9.1 Bend Test -Pliers when tested by bending a hard-drawn l-25-mm steel wire shall work satisfactorily and shall not show any sign of damage or distortion or indentation on the noses on completion of the test. 9.2 Handle Load Test - The pliers shall be tested for deflection and permanent set in accordance with 9.5 of IS : 2615-1964*. The moment to be employed shall be Il.1 7 kgf *rn and the combined deflection and conibined permanent set shall not exceed 12.19 mm and 0.76 mm respectively.

*General requirementsfor pliera,pincen,and nippers.
